task_routing.task_class: read-only inspection, documentation edits, deterministic local tests, and reversible evidence indexing
task_routing.boundary: Repository-only, reversible, with diff and test verification

task_routing.task_class: sustained local operational testing and bounded real-client canary preparation
task_routing.boundary: Stop before external effect, provider spending, or promotion

task_routing.task_class: product wording, tradeoffs, and interpretation of canary value
workflow comparison, targeted fallback expansion, routing, and architecture changes
task_routing.boundary: Human decision with AI evidence, alternatives, and dissent

task_routing.task_class: production enablement, deployment, publication, credential approval, or unverified safety judgment
task_routing.boundary: Human performs or explicitly takes over

bounds.scope: Develop and verify the deterministic hybrid Wrench worker, its independent verifier, two-state client protocol, three named client surfaces, paired productive-value canary, targeted fallback handlers, and sustained local operational behavior.
permissions: read the repository and approved redacted evaluation inputs
make reversible changes inside the repository
run approved local tests and bounded evaluation entry points
exercise the three named client surfaces with bounded read-only or review-only work
prohibited_actions: publish or release an artifact without human approval
spend provider money without an approved child contract
upload customer data or unrestricted private data
weaken verifier, safety, or evidence gates
claim parity or production value from a smoke, HTTP 200, synthetic replay, or offline result
start skipped hardware, dense-native, learned-routing, adapter, or broad packaging work without a new human decision
data_access: client receipts that contain no credentials or unrestricted private data

evidence_required: hash-bound source, artifact, tokenizer, runtime, and verifier identities
paired baseline and Wrench workflow receipts
frontier-token, local-token, cost, latency, retry, correction, abstention, and fallback accounting
sustained concurrency, cancellation, timeout, recovery, and circuit-breaker receipts
human decision receipt before promotion, publication, deployment, or spend

rollback.procedure: Disable learned routing, restore the named source and artifact recovery point, preserve all receipts and failures, and do not rewrite evidence.
rollback.recovery_point: Record source commit, artifact manifest hash, tokenizer hash, runtime identity, verifier identity, and working-tree state before each consequential task.
